column1: # The standard keybindings, the same in every compositor. Change them with `keybinds set ACTION KEYS` or on the
# installer's Keybindings page; your changes go to ~/.config/fedora-noctalia-setup/keybinds.conf.
# kind: spawn (a command), noctalia (a `noctalia msg` command), wm (a window action, translated per compositor).
# flags: repeat (held keys repeat), locked (works on the lock screen).
record|Noctalia|Start/stop screen recording|Super+Shift+S|noctalia|plugin noctalia/screen_recorder:service all toggle|
